title: league_catalog.yaml (v1)
description: Phase 13 — League catalog defining which leagues exist, their tier (T1/T2/T3), and source coverage. Per docs/design/LEAGUE_CATALOG.md §3. Loaded at import time; validates tier values, detects duplicate league_id, and cross-references competition_id.

schema_version.description: Catalog schema version. Bumping requires a migration entry in xops/leagues/migrations/.

leagues.description: Array of league definitions. Each must have a unique league_id.

LeagueRow.description: A single league row in the catalog.

league_id.description: Unique league identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric + underscore. Used as a dict key everywhere.

name_en.description: English display name (for API + English UX).

oneOf.description: ISO-3166 country code (e.g. TR, GB-ENG, ES) or null for international competitions.
For international competitions (UEFA CL, World Cup, etc.), country is null.

confederation.description: Continental confederation or FIFA for world tournaments.

active_since.description: ISO-8601 date when this league became active in the system.

competitions.description: List of competitions (formats) this league supports.

competition_id.description: Unique competition identifier within this league.

source_coverage.description: Which data sources cover which planes for this league.

reference.description: Sources for the Reference plane (historical data).

schedule.description: Sources for the Schedule plane (upcoming fixtures).

live.description: Sources for the Live plane (match updates during play).
